playbookOutputs: Confirmed grade and class of works (one class included)
playbookCommonFailures: Client expects a higher grade than Grade 1 but has supplied no AFS, completion certificates or capital proof — Grade 1 needs none, higher grades do
Director certified ID older than 3 months or certification illegible
TCS PIN expired or company tax status non-compliant
Class of works not chosen, or the client wants more than the one class included in the price
CIDB registration fee unpaid (our fee excludes it), so the application sits unprocessed

informationToProvide.label: Company registration documents (e.g., CIPC COR14.3)
informationToProvide.aiHint: CIPC CoR14.3 (or CK1/CK2) showing the registered name, enterprise number and directors. The CIDB registers the company; directors are captured from this document.

informationToProvide.label: Certified copies of director(s) IDs
alternatives: Certified passport copy for a foreign director
informationToProvide.aiHint: Mandatory CIPC KYC Invariant: South African citizens MUST submit a certified SA ID (Smart ID Card front AND back, or Green Barcoded ID Book) certified within the last 3 months by a Commissioner of Oaths or SAPS — passports are NOT accepted for SA citizens. Foreign nationals ONLY may submit a certified/apostilled foreign passport accompanied by a valid visa/permit. Verify legible ID/passport number, full legal names, and certification stamp date within 90 days.

informationToProvide.label: Proof of construction experience or completed projects
alternatives: Client reference letters with project value and dates
informationToProvide.aiHint: Completion certificates or letters of award in the company's name showing project description, class of works, value (excl. VAT) and completion date, signed by the client / principal agent. Not required for Grade 1; needed for Grade 2 and above to prove track record.

informationToProvide.label: Latest audited financial statements or management accounts
alternatives: Bank statements showing available capital (for Grade 2–3)
informationToProvide.aiHint: Signed AFS or management accounts for the latest financial year. Not required for Grade 1; for higher grades the CIDB uses turnover and available capital from these. ⚠ verify the current grade thresholds on the CIDB site.

informationToProvide.label: Proof of business address (e.g., utility bill)
informationToProvide.aiHint: Utility bill, municipal account or lease in the company's name dated within 3 months.

informationToProvide.label: Tax Compliance Status (TCS) PIN
informationToProvide.aiHint: SARS Tax Compliance Status PIN letter for the company. The CIDB verifies the PIN with SARS; note the PIN and expiry date.

informationToProvide.label: Class of works to register for (one included)
informationToProvide.aiHint: The single CIDB class of works the client wants (e.g. GB General Building, CE Civil Engineering, EB Electrical Building, SB Specialist). Extra classes are charged separately. If the client is unsure, capture what work they actually do so Kevin can choose.

informationToProvide.label: Business Bank Confirmation Letter (In the Company Name, Not Older Than 3 Months)
informationToProvide.helpText: Upload an official stamped or QR-verified bank confirmation letter in the company legal name (< 3 months).
informationToProvide.aiHint: Official bank account confirmation letter from a registered SA bank in the company legal name, dated within 90 days.

informationToProvide.label: CSD Supplier Number (MAAA...), Target CIDB Grade (Grade 1 vs Grades 2–9) & Primary Contact Details (Email & Cellphone)
informationToProvide.helpText: Provide your CSD MAAA supplier number, target CIDB grade (e.g., Grade 1 GB/CE), and the contact email and cellphone number for your CIDB CRS profile.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Collect CIDB registration requirements from client
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: CoR14.3, certified IDs, proof of address, TCS PIN and class of works received; AFS / project proof received if a grade above 1 is wanted
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Chase only what is missing and name why the CIDB needs it. Ask which grade the client expects: Grade 1 needs no financial or project proof; anything higher needs AFS and completion certificates / letters of award. Confirm the single class of works included in the price. Remind that the CIDB's own registration fee is payable by the client and excluded from our fee. Do not promise a shorter turnaround than 1–2 working days for submission; the CIDB's processing takes longer.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Verify documents against CIDB requirements
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: All required uploads pass the rules engine or are approved by Kevin; TCS PIN valid
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: CoR14.3, proof of address and any AFS / project proof in the company's name. Director names on CoR14.3 must match certified IDs; certification within 90 days. Check the TCS PIN expiry. For project proof, extract project value (excl. VAT), class of works, completion date and the principal; flag documents in a director's personal name. Extract enterprise number, income tax number, directors, address, contact person and the requested class.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Prepare CRS application hand-off sheet
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Hand-off sheet with every CRS application field and the recommended grade posted for Kevin
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Mirror the CIDB CRS online application: enterprise details, directors / shareholders with ID numbers, contact details, class of works, requested grade, TCS PIN, and — for grades above 1 — largest completed contract value, turnover and available capital with document references. Recommend a grade with reasoning but mark it as Kevin's call. ⚠ verify current grade thresholds and fees on the CIDB site before quoting either.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Submit registration on the CIDB CRS portal
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Application captured on CRS, CRS number issued, fee reference recorded
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Stage the CRS application (register.cidb.org.za — ⚠ verify URL) with all fields from the hand-off sheet and the uploads attached; Kevin reviews and clicks submit. Record the CRS number and the CIDB fee reference. Draft a client message with the CIDB fee amount and payment details — the application is only processed once the CIDB fee is paid.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Wait for CIDB approval and follow up
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: CIDB certificate available on CRS or a query raised
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Check the CRS status at each follow-up point and draft a status query to the CIDB quoting the CRS number if it has not moved. If the CIDB requests further proof (common for grades above 1), create a proposal for Kevin with the exact request.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Deliver CIDB certificate and CRS number to client
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Certificate and CRS number posted to Communication History
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Post the certificate, CRS number, grade and class. Explain that the registration is renewed annually and that grade upgrades need AFS and project proof; offer the CIDB Annual Renewal and CIDB Upgrade services.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Final sign-off
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Kevin confirms the order can be completed
